40021538.author: पदार्थः
40021538.content: ते Those, प्रयाताः departed, महात्मानः great-souled ones, पार्थिवाः kings, ते those, प्रहृष्टवत् joyfully, गजवाजिसहस्रौघैः with thousands of elephants and horses, कम्पयन्तः shaking, वसुन्धराम् the earth.

40021538.author: Translation
40021538.content: Those great-souled kings departed joyfully, shaking the earth with their throngs of thousands of elephants and horses.

40021539.author: पदार्थः
40021539.content: अक्षौहिण्यो many Akshauhinis, हि indeed, तत्र there, आसन् were, राघवार्थे for the sake of Rama, समुद्यताः prepared, भरतस्य of Bharata, आज्ञया by the command, अनेकाः many, प्रहृष्टाः delighted, बलवाहनाः with strong forces and vehicles.

40021539.author: Translation
40021539.content: Many Akshauhinis, with their delighted forces and vehicles, were indeed present there, prepared for Rama's cause by Bharata's command.

40021540.author: पदार्थः
40021540.content: ऊचुः they said, ते those, च and, महीपालाः kings, बलदर्पसमन्विताः endowed with the pride of strength, न not, रामरावणम् Rama and Ravana, युद्धे in battle, पश्यामः we see, पुरतः in front, स्थितम् standing.

40021540.author: Translation
40021540.content: And those kings, filled with the pride of their strength, said that they did not see Rama and Ravana standing before them in battle.

40021541.author: पदार्थः
40021541.content: भरतेन by Bharata, वयम् we, पश्चात् afterwards, समानीताः brought, निरर्थकम् uselessly, हताः killed, हि indeed, राक्षसाः the Rakshasas, क्षिप्रम् quickly, पार्थिवैः by kings, स्युः would be, न not, संशयः doubt.

40021541.author: Translation
40021541.content: They felt that they had been brought uselessly by Bharata, as the Rakshasas would have certainly been quickly killed by the kings themselves.

40021542.author: पदार्थः
40021542.content: रामस्य of Rama, बाहुवीर्येण by the strength of the arms, रक्षिताः protected, लक्ष्मणस्य of Lakshmana, च and, सुखम् happily, पारेसमुद्रस्य on the other side of the ocean, युध्येम we would fight, विगतज्वराः free from anxiety.

40021542.author: Translation
40021542.content: Protected by the strength of Rama's and Lakshmana's arms, they would have happily fought on the other side of the ocean, free from any anxiety.

40021543.author: पदार्थः
40021543.content: एताः these, च and, अन्याः other, च and, राजानः kings, कथाः stories, तत्र there, सहस्रशः by thousands, कथयन्तः narrating, स्वराज्यानि their own kingdoms, जग्मुः went, हर्षसमन्विताः filled with joy.

40021543.author: Translation
40021543.content: These and many other stories, thousands of them, were narrated by the kings there as they returned to their own kingdoms, filled with joy.

40021544.author: पदार्थः
40021544.content: स्वानि their own, राज्यानि kingdoms, मुख्यानि excellent, ऋद्धानि prosperous, मुदितानि joyful, च and, समृद्धधनधान्यानि rich in wealth and grain, पूर्णानि full, वसुमन्ति possessing wealth, च and.

40021544.author: Translation
40021544.content: Their own excellent and prosperous kingdoms were joyful, full of abundant wealth and grain, and rich in resources.

40021545.author: पदार्थः
40021545.content: यथापुराणि to their respective cities, ते they, गत्वा having gone, रत्नानि jewels, विविधानि various, अथ then, रामस्य of Rama, प्रियकामार्थम् for the sake of pleasing, उपहारान् gifts, नृपाः kings, ददुः gave.

40021545.author: Translation
40021545.content: The kings, having returned to their respective cities, then brought various jewels and gifts to please Rama.

40021546.author: पदार्थः
40021546.content: अश्वान् horses, यानानि vehicles, रत्नानि jewels, हस्तिनः elephants, च and, मदोत्कटान् intoxicated, चन्दनानि sandalwoods, च and, मुख्यानि excellent, दिव्यानि divine, आभरणानि ornaments, च and.

40021546.author: Translation
40021546.content: They presented horses, vehicles, jewels, rutting elephants, excellent sandalwoods, and divine ornaments.

40021547.author: पदार्थः
40021547.content: मणिमुक्ताप्रवालान् gems, pearls, and corals, तु and, दास्यः female servants, रूपसमन्विताः endowed with beauty, अजाविकांश्च goats and sheep, विविधान् various, रथान् chariots, तु and, विविधान् various, ददुः gave.

40021547.author: Translation
40021547.content: They also offered gems, pearls, corals, beautiful female servants, various goats and sheep, and diverse chariots.

40021548.author: पदार्थः
40021548.content: भरतः Bharata, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, च and, एव indeed, शत्रुघ्नः Shatrughna, च and, महाबलाः mighty, आदाय having taken, तानि those, रत्नानि jewels, स्वां their own, पुरीम् city, पुनः again, आगताः returned.

40021548.author: Translation
40021548.content: Bharata, Lakshmana, and the mighty Shatrughna, having received those treasures, then returned to their own city.

40021549.author: पदार्थः
40021549.content: आगम्य having arrived, च and, पुरीं city, रम्याम् beautiful, अयोध्याम् Ayodhya, पुरुषर्षभाः best among men, तानि those, रत्नानि jewels, चित्राणि various, रामाय to Rama, समुपाहरन् offered.

40021549.author: Translation
40021549.content: Having arrived back in the beautiful city of Ayodhya, those best among men presented the various wonderful jewels to Rama.

40021550.author: पदार्थः
40021550.content: प्रतिगृह्य having received, च and, तत्सर्वं all that, रामः Rama, प्रीतिसमन्वितः filled with joy, सुग्रीवाय to Sugriva, ददौ gave, राज्ञे to the king, महात्मा the great-souled one, कृतकर्मणे who had accomplished great deeds.

40021550.author: Translation
40021550.content: The great-souled Rama, filled with joy, received all those gifts and then gave them to King Sugriva, who had accomplished great deeds.

40021551.author: पदार्थः
40021551.content: बिभीषणाय to Vibhishana, च and, ददौ gave, तथा similarly, अन्येभ्यो to others, अपि also, राघवः Rama, राक्षसेभ्यः to the Rakshasas, कपिभ्यश्च and to the Vanaras, यैः by whom, वृतः surrounded, जयम् victory, आप्तवान् obtained.

40021551.author: Translation
40021551.content: Rama similarly gave gifts to Vibhishana and also to the other Rakshasas and Vanaras by whom he was surrounded and with whose help he had achieved victory.

40021552.author: पदार्थः
40021552.content: ते those, सर्वे all, रामदत्तानि given by Rama, रत्नानि jewels, कपिराक्षसाः Vanaras and Rakshasas, शिरोभिः on their heads, धारयामासुः wore, बाहुभिश्च and on their arms, महाबलाः mighty.

40021552.author: Translation
40021552.content: All those mighty Vanaras and Rakshasas wore the jewels given by Rama on their heads and arms.

40021553.author: पदार्थः
40021553.content: हनूमन्तं Hanuman, च and, नृपतिः the king, इक्ष्वाकूणां of the Ikshvakus, महारथः the great warrior, अङ्गदं Angada, च and, महाबाहुम् mighty-armed, अङ्कम् on his lap, आरोप्य having placed, वीर्यवान् the valiant one.

40021553.author: Translation
40021553.content: The valiant King of the Ikshvakus, the great warrior Rama, placed Hanuman and the mighty-armed Angada on his lap.

40021554.author: पदार्थः
40021554.content: रामः Rama, कमलपत्राक्षः lotus-petal-eyed, सुग्रीवम् to Sugriva, इदम् this, अब्रवीत् spoke, अङ्गदः Angada, ते your, सुपुत्रः good son, अयम् this, मन्त्री minister, च and, अपि also, अनिलात्मजः son of Anila (Hanuman),

40021554.author: Translation
40021554.content: Rama, whose eyes resembled lotus petals, spoke to Sugriva, saying that Angada was his good son and Hanuman was also his minister.

40021555.author: पदार्थः
40021555.content: सुग्रीवमन्त्रिते in Sugriva's counsel, युक्तौ engaged, मम my, च and, अपि also, हिते in welfare, रतौ devoted, अर्हतः they deserve, विविधां various, पूजां honors, त्वत्कृते for your sake, वै indeed, हरीश्वर O lord of monkeys,

40021555.author: Translation
40021555.content: O lord of monkeys, Angada and Hanuman, being engaged in your counsel and devoted to my welfare, indeed deserve various honors for your sake.

40021556.author: पदार्थः
40021556.content: इति thus, उक्त्वा having spoken, व्यवमुच्य having removed, अङ्गात् from his body, भूषणानि ornaments, महायशाः the greatly renowned, सः he, बबन्ध tied, महार्हाणि very valuable, तदा then, अङ्गदहनूमतोः on Angada and Hanuman,

40021556.author: Translation
40021556.content: Having spoken thus, the greatly renowned Rama then removed valuable ornaments from his own body and fastened them upon Angada and Hanuman.

40021557.author: पदार्थः
40021557.content: आभाष्य having addressed, च and, महावीर्यान् the very powerful, राघवः Rama, यूथपर्षभान् the best of the troop leaders, नीलम् Nila, नलम् Nala, केसरिणम् Kesarin, कुमुदम् Kumuda, गन्धमादनम् Gandhamadana,

40021557.author: Translation
40021557.content: And Rama then addressed the very powerful best of the troop leaders: Nila, Nala, Kesarin, Kumuda, and Gandhamadana.

40021558.author: पदार्थः
40021558.content: सुषेणम् Sushena, पनसम् Panasa, वीरम् the brave, मैन्दम् Mainda, द्विविदम् Dvivida, एव indeed, च and, जाम्बवन्तम् Jambavan, गवाक्षम् Gavaksha, च and, विनतम् Vinata, धूम्रम् Dhumra, एव indeed, च and,

40021558.author: Translation
40021558.content: He also addressed Sushena, Panasa, the brave Mainda, Dvivida, Jambavan, Gavaksha, Vinata, and Dhumra.

40021559.author: पदार्थः
40021559.content: वलीमुखं Valimukha, प्रजङ्घं Prajangha, च and, सन्नादं Sannada, च and, महाबलम् the mighty, दरीमुखं Darimukha, दधिमुखम् Dadhimukha, इन्द्रजानुं Indrajānu, च and, यूथपम् the troop leader.

40021559.author: Translation
40021559.content: This verse lists the names of several prominent monkey chiefs: Valimukha, Prajangha, the mighty Sannada, Darimukha, Dadhimukha, and Indrajānu, who were all leaders of troops.

40021560.author: पदार्थः
40021560.content: मधुरं sweetly, श्लक्ष्णया with gentle, वाचा words, नेत्राभ्याम् with his eyes, आपिबन्निव as if drinking (them in), सुहृदः friends, मे my, भवन्तश्च you are, शरीरं (part of my) body, भ्रातरः brothers, तथा likewise.

40021560.author: Translation
40021560.content: Speaking sweetly and gently, as if drinking them in with his eyes, Rama declared that they were his friends, his very body, and his brothers.

40021561.author: पदार्थः
40021561.content: युष्माभिः by you, उद्धृतश्च and rescued, अहम् I, व्यसनात् from distress, काननौकसः O dwellers of the forest, धन्यः blessed, राजा king, च and, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, भवद्भिः by you, सुहृदाम् among friends, वरैः the best.

40021561.author: Translation
40021561.content: Rama declared that he, a dweller of the forest, was rescued from distress by them, and King Sugriva was blessed to have them, the best among friends.

40021562.author: पदार्थः
40021562.content: एवम् thus, उक्त्वा having spoken, ददौ he gave, तेभ्यः to them, भूषणानि ornaments, यथार्हतः as was fitting, वज्राणि diamonds, च and, महार्हाणि very valuable, सस्वजे he embraced, च and, नरर्षभः the best among men.

40021562.author: Translation
40021562.content: Having spoken thus, Rama, the best among men, gave them ornaments and very valuable diamonds as was fitting, and also embraced them.

40021563.author: पदार्थः
40021563.content: ते they, पिबन्तः drinking, सुगन्धीनि fragrant, मधूनि honey, मधुपिङ्गलाः tawny like honey (the monkeys), मांसानि meats, च and, सुमृष्टानि well-prepared, मूलानि roots, च and, फलानि fruits, च and.

40021563.author: Translation
40021563.content: The monkeys, tawny like honey, drank fragrant honey and ate well-prepared meats, roots, and fruits.

40021564.author: पदार्थः
40021564.content: एवं thus, तेषां of them, निवसतां while dwelling, मासः a month, साग्रो with a part (more than), ययौ passed, तदा then, मुहूर्तमिव like a moment, ते they, सर्वे all, रामभक्त्या due to devotion to Rama, च and, मेनिरे considered.

40021564.author: Translation
40021564.content: While they were thus dwelling, more than a month passed, yet all of them perceived it as merely a moment due to their profound devotion to Rama.

40021565.author: पदार्थः
40021565.content: रामः Rama, अपि also, रेमे enjoyed, तैः with them, सार्धं together with, वानरैः with monkeys, कामरूपिभिः who could change form at will, राक्षसैः with Rakshasas, च and, महावीर्यैः of great valor, ऋक्षैः with bears, च and, एव indeed, महाबलैः of great strength.

40021565.author: Translation
40021565.content: Rama also delighted in the company of those form-changing monkeys, the greatly valorous Rakshasas, and the exceedingly strong bears.

40021566.author: पदार्थः
40021566.content: एवं thus, तेषां of them, ययौ passed, मासः a month, द्वितीयः the second, शिशिरः cool/pleasant, सुखम् happily, वानराणां of the monkeys, प्रहृष्टानां who were greatly delighted, राक्षसानां of the Rakshasas, च and, सर्वशः entirely.

40021566.author: Translation
40021566.content: Thus, for all those greatly delighted monkeys and Rakshasas, the second pleasant month passed happily.

40021567.author: पदार्थः
40021567.content: इक्ष्वाकुनगरे in the city of Ikshvaku, रम्ये beautiful, परां supreme, प्रीतिम् joy, उपासताम् while experiencing, रामस्य of Rama, प्रीतिकरणैः by the acts causing joy, कालः time, तेषां of them, सुखं happily, ययौ passed.

40021567.author: Translation
40021567.content: While they were experiencing supreme joy in the beautiful city of Ikshvaku, time passed happily for them due to Rama's delightful actions. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे एकोनचत्वारिंशः सर्गः ।। 39 ।। Thus ends the thirty-ninth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
